gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diffuse Intrinsic Pontine Gliomas (DIPG); Progressive DIPG; Refractory DIPG; Recurrent DIPG; H3K27-altered High Grade Glioma

candidate_evidence.quote: ACT001: PO BID at 875 mg/m2 for 28 days

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients will be enrolled on either Cohort A for newly diagnosed DIPG or on Cohort B \[ENROLLMENT PAUSED\] for those with progressive / refractory DIPG or progressive / recurrent / refractory H3K27-altered HGG.

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Cohort A: Patients with newly-diagnosed DIPG with typical MRI findings (interventions: Drug: ACT001)

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational oral agent (ACT001, parthenolide derivative per exclusion criterion naming parthenolide)

source_quote.quote: Patients with DIPG (no biopsy required), pathologically-confirmed (at diagnosis or recurrence) H3K27-altered DIPG, or extra-pontine H3K27-alteredHGG who have progressive/recurrent or refractory disease

coder_notes: Paediatric/young-adult DIPG and H3K27-altered HGG; glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title, eligibility or arm labels. Ages 12 months to 39 years. Prior temozolomide with RT is only permitted prior therapy, not a registered intervention.
